purpose: Provides the website booking callout for a safe external booking link or manual follow-up; automated slot selection is a package-level target, not implemented in the current website template.

outputSchema.description: Target booking request event for schedule-appointment; the current website template does not emit it

supportedIntegrations: External HTTPS booking link (link-out only); other listed modes are planned

configurationFields.description: Required for the supported Calendly Link mode; opens as an external link, not an embed

testCases.description: Request a slot inside business hours
testCases.expectedOutcome: Request accepted and forwarded to schedule-appointment

testCases.description: Request a slot outside business hours or in the past
Calendly Link mode renders the external booking callout
testCases.expectedOutcome: Configured safe URL opens in a new tab; no API calls are made from the site

knownLimitations: The current website template supports a safe external Calendly-style HTTPS link (opened in a new tab) and manual follow-up only; it does not embed a calendar or submit booking requests.
APB-01 and APB-02 describe target scheduling behavior and are not implemented or verified. The Calendly link is not an embedded widget.
Built-in mode creates requests, not confirmed bookings; staff confirm in the calendar.
rollbackApproach: Switch booking.type to 'Manual Follow-up Only' in site.config.json and redeploy.

implementation.verifiedBy: Angular unit tests and production build in CI; scheduling integration is not implemented
